verdicts.reason: Both share the same serious faults. The cream circle meant to sit behind the can has come loose and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, so the can is just a thin outline that disappears into the orange. The headline is undersized for the canvas. The left-aligned text clashes with the centered can and CTA. 'Out now.' is low-contrast dark text floating far below its headline. A also leaves a large empty band at the top and puts the can between the copy and the 'Try It' button, which splits the CTA from its message. B at least keeps the headline, subline and CTA together in one block under the product, so it is marginally more coherent.
